Title: Patrologiae graecae tomus CLI: Gregorius Palamas, Gregorius Acindynus, Barlaam. Gregorii Palamae, Thessalonicensis archiepiscopi, Opera omnia theologica, homiletica, hagiographica, polemica, ascetica. Accedunt Gregorii Acindyni, Barlaami de Seminaria opuscula, epistolae. Gregorii tomus posterior, caeterorum tomus unicus
Creator: Gregory Palamas (c. 1296-1359), archbishop of Thessalonica; with Gregory Akindynos and Barlaam of Calabria; Greek texts with parallel Latin, edited by J.-P. Migne
Publisher: Paris: J.-P. Migne (Petit-Montrouge), Patrologiae cursus completus, Series graeca, tomus 151
Publication Date: 1865
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: the second title page reads '1865' in this scan's OCR (file line 241); host record: date field 1857 (the series start), possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
Language: grc (Greek with parallel or following Latin translation; the Latin and Greek share the OCR file; see the content note)
Source: Internet Archive item patrologicursus36migngoog (archive.org/details/patrologicursus36migngoog), full-text file patrologicursus36migngoog_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows it unchanged. Nothing was stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped (the long s glyph occurs 18 times and was left as found). The Google Books boilerplate page at the head of the OCR is left in place. The OCR text that follows is 1957751 bytes, 1241911 characters and 33742 lines. OCR quality sampled at the title pages and at about 5%, 50% and 95% of the file (lines 1700, 16884 and 32067): Greek polytonic readable with chi for kappa slips; Latin clean.
Content note: Tomus 151 as its ELENCHUS lists it: Palamas, two sermons and forty-three homilies (from the Jerusalem edition of 1857); the editor's notices and Philotheos Kokkinos's encomium of Palamas; the three synodal tomes against the Barlaamites and Akindynists (Tomus synodicus), with Palamas's confession of faith, the bishops' report to Anna Palaiologina and John Kantakouzenos's rescript confirming the sentence on Calecas; Philotheos's twelve Antirrhetici against Gregoras; then the writings of Akindynos and Barlaam. The volume holds the winning side's documents and the condemned side's own tracts together.

EDITORIS PATROLOGLE 
MONITUM. 


Sequentia monumenta (1), que ad Gregorii Palame vitam et placita spectant, excludere 
primum statueramus; at re maturius perpensa, consilium mutavimus rationibus potissimum 
moti quas hic Lectori exponemus, eum sutfragium suum additurum confidentes. 1* Palami- 
tarum heresis, jam inde ἃ multis seculis ipsa absurditate sua explosa, nunc ad historiam 
pertinet, et ne alicui periculo sit ejus expositio nullo modo timendum est, precipue cum 
egregii et sancti viri eam refutandi curam in se susceperint quorum scripta edidimus vef 
edemus. 2* Per hanc expositionem nihil de Ecclesie corona detrahitur; imo gloria ejus 
augmentum inde recipit ; nam miserrima heresis argumenta in medium producendo, 
Ecclesie de ea triumphum celebramus. Tertia denique, eaque potissima ratio est quod 
doctissimus Episcopus ille qui nos in laboribus nostris sepe quasi manu duzit, nobis au« 
ctor fuit at ea monumenta ederemus ; quod certe noluisset fieri, si aliquid periculi subesse 
credidisset. Ea tamen Greece tantum exhibemus, quia pars non sunt orthodoxe traditio- 
nis que in libris nostris reviviscit.
